We got your covered: Secure your resources with the advanced encryption and decryption methods!

HIVE protects and manages your data through encryption, key management, authentication and access management. We are here to accelerate your digital transformation thereby reducing the risks and complexity that arises. HIVE is designed to fortify your digital defences with a proven method of making successful data encryption and decryption standards.

With an intention of eliminating any mathematical relationship between the path and encryption values in the cells, we eliminate issues inherited from the classic encryption methods like AES. HIVE proposes a brute-force approach to leverage faster results. Our innovation takes place on the unicode characters hexadecimal values with 4-bits at a time instead of taking 1-bit at a time - To foster speed and efficiency.

Our methodology will overcome the shortcomings of current encryption methods by using the 2D/3D and 4D numerical map as an encryption function. We make the encryption path as a key-stream generated from a symmetric secrete encryption key between the sender and receiver.

For your business and data:

  • Easily scalable complexity
  • Better confusion and diffusion values
  • Consistent function from encryption path
  • Unique encryption sessions

Our story:

Organized, Adaptive, Impenetrable.

The HIVE: Nature's blueprint for encryption - BEEHIVE!

HIVE serves aș a guardian behind every secure connection and we come up with a conceptual framework of developing a robust encryption system, just like a beehive. We lay the foundation with precise architecture and protocol as a structure, and embed the key management and access control as roles. Our intense system acts as a defence mechanism against intrusion with distributed cooperation.

Our fresh look:

HIVE stands out from other conventional encryption standards and algorithms by showcasing a cipher text uniqueness and Fourier transform analysis. HIVE encryption derives value that are proven to be better than the traditional AES standards.

HIVE infrastructure holds the best global security standards that will protect and helps you to identity, assess and monitor the risks across clouds, third-party provider and organizational sites. We are FAST, EASY and SECURE with deep visibility into your internet-facing assets.

Uncover risks above and beyond:

Achieve compliance - You can reach your compliance goals faster by making use of the encryption and decryption strategies

Change the paradigm of how and where your organizations can leverage data to unlock values!

Are you skilled in managing your business risks?
